title: Rounded bay-window caps no longer vanish when seen from above
items: Ten shallow, rounded bay-window caps on eight Prairie Avenue houses (1619, 1621, 1637, 1721, 1801, 1808, 1828 and 1905) were built inside out. From above they disappeared, leaving the bay open to the sky. Each now shows its roof from every side. From the street they look the same as before, and every picture these houses are checked against still matches.
